run_GTestOutputTest_testOutput: run the GTestOutputTest testOutput method to compare Google Test output against the golden file
run_gengolden_flag: run the script with --gengolden flag to regenerate the golden output file from test commands
test_RemoveLocations: test the RemoveLocations function to strip file path and line number info from test output
test_NormalizeOutput: test the NormalizeOutput function to normalize test output by removing locations, stack traces, and time
test_GetOutputOfAllCommands: test the GetOutputOfAllCommands function to get concatenated output from color, time, disabled, and sharding commands
